target_brief: Approximately 1.8 m male tactical character with rigged fitted clothing and complete gloves/forearms; source fidelity review only

actual_candidate.body: male_generic proxy over MPFB hm08 male basemesh
actual_candidate.rig: MPFB v2.0.17 GameEngine, 53 joints, hm08 weight source
actual_candidate.gloved_forearms_reason: Safe forearm extraction and deformed cuff/hand fit were not verified; source geometry was not arbitrarily cut.

tooling.execution: isolated user resources/extensions, factory startup, disable autoexec, offline mode, four CPU threads
tooling.license_separation: MPFB code GPL-3.0-or-later stays in isolated tooling; bundled basemesh/rig/weights CC0 are asset data, not runtime program code.

known_failures: EMT red/white garment and green gloves do not match the desired tactical visual direction
jacket/vest, sleeve/glove, and pants/boots show overlap or visible clipping
the original has six BLEND/doubleSided materials; independent Three.js review proved body/jacket/pants OPAQUE fixes head transparency, while final glove OPAQUE and vest/boots MASK remain diagnostic
eye meshes are absent from this candidate
124k source triangles before masking, 105616 exported triangles and 62.5 MB GLB exceed any unproven runtime budget
specular source textures for vest/boots are not mapped by MPFB GameEngine material bridge
independent art, true renderer, deformation and performance gates have not passed
